note: Append-only. A call goes up the day it goes public and gets checked on its check date. Misses stay up. Prices: 130point sold listings and TCGplayer market prices; retail prices as announced.

items.text: Raw Base Set Charizard is down 10% or more by Oct 30. The reprint lands on the raw copies.
items.start: Sep 28: $944.53, TCGplayer market price for Base Set Charizard 4/102 (unlimited, raw).
items.method: Hit if the TCGplayer market price is $850.08 or lower on Oct 30.
items.latest: The 30th Celebration reprint hit shelves Sep 16.

items.text: Base Set Charizard PSA 10 holds its price. The graded population is closed, so the reprint can't enter it.
items.start: Sep 28: $33,000, the median of four September sales on 130point ($28,750 to $37,500).
items.method: Hit if October's median sale on 130point is $33,000 or higher. Needs at least two October sales.
items.latest: The 30th Celebration reprint hit shelves Sep 16.

items.text: The 30th Celebration Booster Bundle's premium collapses once it ships Oct 2. The ETB holds its premium better.
items.start: Sep 28 on TCGplayer: Booster Bundle $109.06 (presale), 4.4x its $24.99 retail. Elite Trainer Box $160.14, 3.2x its $49.99 retail.
items.method: Hit if the bundle's multiple over retail is cut at least in half by Oct 30 and falls further than the ETB's.
